title: Community Canvas
slide_intent: Give different people a shared presentation structure so audiences can see individual identity and group membership together.
strategic_value: Consistent creator-card alignment can make Twitch’s community feel connected without giving every creator the same expression.
demonstration: Three portrait cards pair Valkyrae, DrLupo and AnneMunition with Twitch signatures and handles; orange guides connect their portraits across the row.
practical_value: Use the guide lines to compare portrait scale and alignment while varying the person and background.

content_islands.name: Card row
content_islands.spec: Align three portrait cards in one row, with Twitch above and each slash-prefixed handle below.

content_islands.name: Alignment annotations
content_islands.spec: Preserve the two orange horizontal strokes spanning the portraits.

reference_purposes.Intent: The Community Canvas caption explains balancing community diversity with a unified brand presence.
reference_purposes.Application: Orange guide lines demonstrate consistent portrait placement across three named creator cards.

ingredient.name: Creator card structure
ingredient.role: Connect individual creators to a common platform.
ingredient.application: Compare portrait scale and alignment within the recurring signature–portrait–handle arrangement.
ingredient.scope: Observed in the historical COLLINS identity case study; no mandatory dimensions, color proportions or universal placement rule is supplied.
